summary.text: Sara Bertschinger is the Republican candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 20B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Democrat Steve Holm.
A registered nurse, she defeated Brady Rouhoff in the August 11, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Sara Bertschinger earned an associate degree from Rochester Community College and works as a registered nurse.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a wife, nurse and citizen advocate running to preserve the district's conservative rural values.
She listed accountability and transparency in government, lower taxes and less regulation, and family and community values among her key messages.
Her stated policy interests include elections and civics, health and human services, energy and economic growth.
